sources.label: Crazy Erudite
sources.author: Crazy Erudite
patch_list: Replaces the loading screen shown when a video starts with your own video. WebM (VP9 or AV1) or MP4 (H.265/HEVC).
Removes ads (splash, banners, popups, interstitials and native ads).
Recolors the app's accent (selected tabs, buttons, highlights, progress) from the stock orange to a purple gradient. Does not change the layout of any screen.

sources.label: Modo Patches
sources.author: latanvillegas
patch_list: Hides the Android status bar and removes the window's top layout reservation without hiding bottom navigation.
Enter native Android PiP when leaving the Movie video player.
Makes verified Movie interface surfaces pure black.
Removes Movie-owned status bar spacers, including their runtime measured height, and home header top spacing.
Adds a fullscreen video quality popup using real ExoPlayer tracks and preserves audio/subtitle overrides.
